title: Build a loop along the trails
description: The anchor points can be moved, with the line and the climbs compared after each change.

blocks.text: An automatic join can run differently from what the person expected.

quote.text: App claims to select routes using trails and roads. I have tried to get it to use the trails and footpaths but it won’t.

blocks.text: Mark which stretches were snapped and which were drawn by hand, highlight the part that was rebuilt and offer an undo. Before saving, look over the whole chosen path.
Calculating a route does not confirm that every stretch can be walked.
